motivating_context: S23 mixed ADAUSDT/XRPUSDT/DOGEUSDT into the SAME single-global-position cluster as ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT/BNBUSDT using S20 H1's config unchanged, and got a worse result (PF 0.860) than S20's original three-symbol result (PF 1.066) — plausibly because the added candidates competed for and sometimes won the one shared position slot away from higher-quality majors signals. This protocol isolates the question the mixed test could not answer cleanly: does S20 H1's exact mechanism (unchanged) perform differently on a smaller-cap, plausibly less efficient altcoin cluster ON ITS OWN, not diluted by/competing with BTC-correlated majors? XRPUSDT, SUIUSDT and DOGEUSDT are used (SUI replacing ADA versus S23, chosen for its shorter, more volatile history and no prior use in this project).

hypotheses.entry_exit: byte-for-byte identical to S20 H1 (order_block_oi_confirmation_scalp, route='oi', partial_r=1.5, trail_atr=2.5, target_r=8.0, default 5x leverage cap) — regime, structure, OBV, OI confirmation and exit management completely unchanged
hypotheses.universe: XRPUSDT, SOLUSDT is NOT included here — SUIUSDT, DOGEUSDT only; single global position across these three, same discipline as S20's three-symbol cluster

hypotheses.entry_exit: identical to H1 except leverage=30 (the platform's cap) and fixed_margin_usd/max_margin_fraction raised proportionally so 30x genuinely changes position size rather than being capped elsewhere unused — a direct, honest test of the user's specific suggestion that higher leverage could reach the stated dollar target. Per S22's already-measured finding (leverage does not change PF/expectancy, only dollar magnitude and margin-halt sensitivity), this hypothesis is not expected to out-PERFORM H1 in PF terms — it exists to show, on this specific universe, exactly what 30x does and does not buy, honestly.

single_variable_isolated: H1 changes only the traded universe versus S20 H1 (majors -> alts). H2 changes only leverage/sizing versus H1 — nothing else in either hypothesis touches the entry signal, regime, structure, flow or OI confirmation logic.

symbols.note: XRPUSDT klines/funding/metrics already cached from S23; SUIUSDT and DOGEUSDT downloaded fresh for this protocol.

promotion_gates.development_to_validation: PF >1.05, net PnL >0, at least 40 fills
promotion_gates.validation_to_retrospective_evaluation: base PF >1.10, stress PF >=1.00, at least 20 base fills, at least 2/3 symbols net positive, no symbol >60% gross profit
promotion_gates.paper_to_live: at least 200 prospective candidates across three full frozen months, PF >=1.25 base and >=1.10 stress, expectancy >=0.10R, 95% session-block bootstrap lower bound >0, max DD <=4%

execution.one_global_position: single global minute event loop with one shared cash balance, pending order and open position across the three-symbol alt cluster
execution.ambiguous_bar: stop first; no favorable exit on limit fill minute
execution.note: H2's higher leverage/notional changes fixed_risk_usd/fixed_margin_usd/max_margin_fraction as declared above; daily_stop_usd/weekly_stop_usd stay fixed in dollars regardless, same disclosed choice as S22.

selection: Exactly H1 and H2. No parameter grid over displacement/ADX/OI thresholds — those stay at S20's values so this measures the universe/leverage question cleanly, not a re-tuned strategy. A failing gate stops that route; choose no least-bad winner.
stress_semantics: Stress and severe are deployability replays: higher costs and limit penetration are known before entry, so the reward/cost filter is reapplied and the fill cohort may shrink.
known_limitations: Order-block displacement/volume thresholds and OI-confirmation logic were designed and validated on ETH/SOL/BNB; alts may have structurally different volatility and OI dynamics this protocol does not re-tune for.
SUIUSDT has a shorter public trading history than the majors; its warmup and development windows are still fully covered by available archives, but its own history as a listed instrument is younger.
Same order-block, OI, ATR-freeze and no-order-book-reconstruction simplifications as S18/S20.

This is a retrospective diagnostic; not a live paper-forward result. It cannot demonstrate a $25/day outcome on $250 capital — see the capital-math discussion already given to the user; this protocol tests edge quality on a different universe, not a dollar target.
